own_solution.law: Successive exponential attenuation gives I_out/I_0 = exp[-15(0.30) - 80t] = 1/10000. Therefore t = [ln(10000) - 4.5]/80 = 0.0588792546 m = 5.88792546 cm. For an additional concrete thickness q expressed in cm, t in cm is 5.88792546 - (15/80)q. At q = 4.3, 7.7 and 11.4 cm, the answers are respectively 5.08167546, 4.44417546 and 3.75042546 cm.
assumptions: The stated exponential attenuation model applies successively to both materials.
Thicknesses are converted to metres when used with attenuation coefficients in inverse metres.
The added concrete on the current wall lies in the beam path.

notes: All certified answers agree with the attenuation law after converting thickness units. The unshielded intensity cancels for every listed positive intensity. All additional concrete thicknesses leave a positive required lead thickness.
